note: E20 Q1 (owner agreed 9 Nov 2026). Load = render time / buffer period on one M1 performance core, 2.67 ms block. R1: mean at most 25%, p99.9 at most 50%, and twice the mean under 80% (a rebuild fade renders two snapshots). R2 and R3: mean at most 50%, judged on the critical path with two worker threads (the refw rows of n60_bench --workers 2), not on the single-thread run; the fade rule (twice the mean under 80%) is judged on the same rows for R2. R3 is judged on the fade rule too (G33 closed: worker row 384 kHz is 22% mean on an M4, 33% hosted). p99.9 cells are the best of the runs (default 5, at least best-of-3) so one noisy run on the shared runner cannot fail a row; no budget value was changed. R4-R7 have no published budget; they are tracked against the baseline only. Enforced in macos-full with --enforce-budgets (E20 S10).
